scope: The three frozen V1 benchmark lessons at 640x360 and 12 fps.

scene_pass_definition.v1: The real V1 scene renderer succeeds and emits no unique warning beginning with 'Text truncated:' and no warning containing 'omitted due to canvas overflow'.
scene_pass_definition.v2: The real V2 scene renderer succeeds, deterministic QA passes, and every TextRenderEvidence.truncated flag is false.

limitations: This is an objective static text-integrity proxy, not an aesthetics or pedagogy score.
It is intentionally renderer-level and does not use a VLM judge.
A later full benchmark may add human/VLM aesthetic metrics without changing this frozen Core Gate proxy post hoc.
